## Breaking changes

### `ona_project` initializer specs take exactly one of `context_url` or `git`

An initializer spec entry that sets both `context_url` and `git` now fails with `Invalid initializer spec`. Previously both were accepted in a single entry. Split them into separate entries:

```diff
 resource "ona_project" "example" {
   name = "example"

   initializer = {
     specs = [
-      {
-        context_url = { url = "https://github.com/example/repo" }
-        git         = { remote_uri = "https://github.com/example/repo.git" }
-      },
+      { context_url = { url = "https://github.com/example/repo" } },
+      { git = { remote_uri = "https://github.com/example/repo.git" } },
     ]
   }
 }
```

### Default `base_url` is now `https://app.ona.com/api`

Configurations that relied on the default previously targeted `https://app.gitpod.io/api`. Set `base_url` (or `GITPOD_BASE_URL`) explicitly to keep using the old endpoint.

## Changes

- Migrated to `gitpod-io/gitpod-sdk-go` v1.1.0, which replaces the REST client with the Connect API. Every resource and data source now issues Connect requests; schemas are otherwise unchanged.
- Retries and `request_timeout` are handled by a provider-owned HTTP transport, because the v1 SDK no longer exposes the request options the provider used. Retry rules mirror the previous SDK: retry on transport errors and on 408, 409, 429 and 5xx, with `x-should-retry` overriding the status code, and honouring `RateLimit-RetryAfter`, `Retry-After-Ms` and `Retry-After`. `request_timeout` continues to apply per attempt rather than across the whole retry sequence.
- `max_retries` documents its default as `2` directly rather than deferring to the SDK default. The effective value is unchanged.
- Updated module dependencies to their latest patch and minor releases.
